author: lishunyang12
body: This only validates video quality, but H3's FP8 DiT also generates audio. Could we add at least an audio validity/quality check?

author: lishunyang12
body: Please document that H3 FP8 is currently incompatible with layerwise offload; otherwise users will hit the flattened-weight stride failure.

author: mglyn
body: Added. The quality test now checks the 32 kHz audio output using multi-resolution spectral cosine and RMS ratio. The latest BF16/FP8 A/B achieved 0.9589 cosine and 0.9342x RMS ratio.

author: mglyn
body: Documented in both the FP8 support matrix and the H3 recipe. H3 online FP8 is currently incompatible with layerwise offload due to the flattened-weight stride rejected by the Cutlass kernel.
